newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks edge up at close in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks edge up at close in dull trading.

text.p: Pakistan stocks edged up at Friday's close in lacklustre trading as investors and institutions kept to the sidelines ahead of the weekend, dealers said.

"It was a dull session. Volumes fell even in speculative stocks," dealer Ather Raouf said. "There is no selling pressure as such. Investors appear to be in a wait-see-mood before 1997/98 budget (July-June)," said dealer Mudassar Malik. The budget is due in mid-June. The index rose 0.63 points, or 0.04 percent, to end at 1,539.45. Losers led gainers 115 to 61. PTCL rose 0.20 rupees to 25. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
